machines.description: Named remote machines, keyed by the `machine` argument value.

MachineConfig.description: Timing and concurrency the origin owner chose for one machine binding.

binding.description: Destination binding to use; the destination owner installed it.

lease_ms.description: Fixed execution lease offered by each renewal, in milliseconds.

max_concurrent_calls.description: Calls that may hold a lease on this machine at the same time.

pairing.description: Pairing record created by `oqt_link pair` (state, not config).

renew_ms.description: Interval between destination renewal challenges; at most half the lease.
